minutes.headline: Planning Board approved an ANR and a site plan waiver, and continued the 1325 Mass Ave hearing to Feb 27 for a draft decision.
minutes.summary: The Planning Board heard a stormwater update on Holman Street, endorsed an ANR for 100 Howard Street, and waived site plan approval for 1259 Mass Ave. It spent most of the evening on the 1325 Mass Ave public hearing (landscaping, lighting, sewer traps, parking, MEPA) and continued it to the next meeting. It also reviewed three master plan RFP responses, set interviews, and discussed using GIS hours for Conservation.

public_comment.topic: Attorney for buyers of 147 Holman Street asked the board to vote favorably on the stormwater issue on the 27th so the closing can occur; cited rising interest rates.
Abutters at 1325 Mass Ave commented on landscaping plant size and building lighting; a written comment from abutters was noted.

votes.outcome: passed 3-0 by roll call (Wilsmer, Reed, chair aye)

contention.about: Whether building code requires floor drains and grease interceptors in the contractor garage bays, and whether the site plan can be approved with one MDC trap.
contention.sides: A board member questioned the sewer/trap approach; the applicant's engineer and land use director said it is the Sewer Commission's domain and does not change the site plan.
contention.words_as_heard: I don't think we can comfortably approve a site plan review for one MDC trap

what_happened.line: The Planning Board continued the 1325 Mass Ave public hearing to February 27; a draft decision is to be prepared for that meeting, when the hearing could be closed.
The board approved an ANR plan for 100 Howard Street, 3-0 by roll call.
The board accepted a waiver from site plan approval for 1259 Mass Ave, 3-0 by roll call.
The board reviewed three master plan RFP responses and will schedule interviews with the three bidders at its next meeting; price proposals have not yet been seen.
A vote on using the town's MRPC GIS hours for Conservation is to go on the next agenda.

why_it_matters: The 1325 Mass Ave hearing is still open, so abutters' concerns about landscaping and lighting can still be raised before a decision is written and the hearing is closed.
The master plan consultant choice is made from three bids whose prices the board had not yet seen, so the cost of that planning work is still undetermined.
watch_next: February 27 Planning Board meeting: draft decision on 1325 Mass Ave, possible close of the hearing, master plan RFP interviews, and the GIS hours vote for Conservation.

reconciliation.summary: The two records agree on the two votes both contain (the 100 Howard Street ANR and the 1259 Mass Ave waiver), and on Brenner's absence and the GIS and master plan follow-ups. They differ mainly because the official minutes say nothing about the 1325 Massachusetts Avenue hearing or its continuance vote, which is the one thing to check. The official minutes also cover Holman Street, Lunenburg Central, Pond View HAC and other items that our minutes lack.
